summary: Scope is where in the code a variable can be used. In Java, a variable exists only from its declaration to the closing brace of its block.
notes: message is declared inside the if braces, so it is gone after the closing brace.
status is declared before the if, so it still exists after the if ends.
totalPoints is a static field of the class, so addPoints() and main() share it.
pitfall: Using a variable outside the braces where it was declared causes the compile error: cannot find symbol.
